snippet.title: Untergrund Raceways - Arena: Main Release Trailer (11th of September)
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5087440/Untergrund_Raceways__Arena/

Untergrund Raceways - Arena (URA) is a chaotic kart arena fighter by Vantech Studios in cooperation with AAP.

Features:
• 26 unique arenas
• 1v1 to 50-player modes for variety
• 40 crazy items
• 37–40 characters from the AAP universe
• Challenging, player-like AI with no cheats
• Extensive customization options
• Tournament mode, statistics & achievements
• Splitscreen for up to 4 players
• Lots of individual settings

Whether you're new to AAP or a long-time fan, URA is accessible for everyone while offering plenty of secrets and lore nods for those in the know.
